question: Who among the following was defeated in the battle of Chanderi in 1528?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Medini Rai.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Battle of Chanderi:-**

 
 
• It was fought on January 20, 1528, between the Mughal forces of Babur and the Rajput forces of Medini Rai, the ruler of Malwa.
 
• The battle took place in the aftermath of the Battle of Khanwa, in which Babur had defeated a Rajput confederacy led by Rana Sanga.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Babur** was the founder of the **Mughal Empire in India **and ruled from **1526 to 1530.**
 
• **Shershah Suri** was a ruler of the **Sur dynasty** who **defeated Humayun,** the son of Babur, and established the **Sur Empire** in India.
 
• **Sikandar Lodi ** was the most important ruler of the Lodi Dynasty, a part of India's Delhi Sultanate.
 
• He ascended Bahlul Lodi and was the dynasty's second ruler.
 
• In 1504 CE, he founded Agra city and made it his new Capital (earlier Delhi).
 
• **Ibrahim Lodi**** **was a ruler of the **Lodi dynasty **who ruled **Delhi before Babur's invasion.**
